conclusion: No actionable newly introduced comment/documentation accuracy defect found in the pinned remediation scope. This is a narrow Comment Review, not global comment or implementation clearance.

verified_traces.claim: The new enum describes validation observation rather than ownership/presentation.
verified_traces.evidence: BlockingScopes pushes a native Validation-only error scope; Uncaptured returns no guard. start_scope exists only outside wasm32. from_parts selects Uncaptured; newly created native devices select BlockingScopes, browser creation selects Uncaptured. Presentation determines canvas/surface/blitter separately. Context docs accurately state constructor defaults and explicitly qualify separate validation paths and lack of global health/rollback proof. Public callers can choose policy explicitly; comments are not treated as an immutable ownership invariant.

verified_traces.claim: The same policy is carried through the affected shader/pipeline/compute paths.
verified_traces.evidence: Each affected native source calls validation_observation.start_scope; compile passes the context policy and the direct pipeline convenience method deliberately selects BlockingScopes. Browser branches do not invoke start_scope or block. The guide claims shared observation choice, not identical progress/error handling for every caller. Existing paths that still discard poll results remain separate qualifications.

verified_traces.claim: Guide/view error contracts and Display templates remain consistent.
verified_traces.evidence: Cached-format returns still precede native texture admission and preserve Arc sharing; missing cache/native errors have no source. Requested format is retained while storage view descriptors may use its linear counterpart. Native rejection preserves per-operation cause; Progress retains request/operation/poll/captured rejection. Manual source returns inner concrete errors. Display derive attributes reproduce all prior templates/prefixes from the parent diff; ValidationScopeError tuple templates forward the same inner Display and explicit source fields. The guide example remains a text fence, not a new doctest.

verified_traces.claim: Manual boxed source rationale explains an actual downcast constraint.
verified_traces.evidence: An explicitly derived source over these Box fields invokes AsDynError on the boxed field and returns that concrete Box error, while the manual as_ref returns its inner wgpu::Error or ValidationProgressError. Progress and native boxes have different concrete types, so their current typed cause bindings cannot share one or-pattern arm. The rationale is read in that source-selection context; it is not a claim that a bare Error derive without source annotations automatically identifies a named cause field.

verified_traces.claim: Native scope docs accurately avoid an infinite-success guarantee.
verified_traces.evidence: wait_indefinitely constructs Wait with no explicit timeout/index; device.poll returns Result and native wait can fail. finish observes the poll result and then explicitly pops its same-thread scope before matching both outcomes. No view is returned on a finish error. No success/rollback/device-health claim is inferred.
